about_the_game:
Better Fortress 2 is a community-centered modded continuation of Team Fortress 2 that aims to bring new improvement and fixes while also restoring old removed & unused features, items, gamemodes, and more, as well as implement and showcase new community content like items, war paints, maps, gamemodes, and weapons, all with the goal of being a playground to showcase what could be one day getting changes added to the live game.

Currently implemented feature include:

  • MvM versus; Play as both Red and Blu team with Blu team taking over the robot including the Giants, Gatebots, and normal bots

  • nav_generate has been updated; now reloads the navmesh only instead of reloading the whole map

  • Sniper callout: A "SNIPER!" Voice line for ever class

  • Community weapons from OFFSHORE; The Holy Marlin & The Hell Beneath

  • New and fixed convars; sv_infinite_ammo, bf_teaserprops works now along with bf_teaserprops_type, tf_max_speed; allows you to change the max speed of classes, tf_voicespam and tf_max_voice_speak_delay.

and more coming soon!

Want to help contribute to the mod? Join our discord as we are always looking for new things to add and showcase, all with correct permission of course!
